$comment: ACP agent runtimes, recorded from the ACP Registry index. Meridian does not bundle an AI: it governs one you already have. These say how each is launched; you supply the account.

runtimes.name: Claude Agent
runtimes.requires: Node.js, so that npx is on PATH
runtimes.auth: Sign in with your Anthropic account, or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in your environment before starting VS Code. Meridian never asks for it and never stores it.

runtimes.name: Gemini CLI
runtimes.requires: Node.js, so that npx is on PATH
runtimes.auth: Sign in with `gemini auth`, or set GEMINI_API_KEY in your environment. Meridian never asks for it and never stores it.

runtimes.name: Codex CLI
runtimes.requires: Node.js, so that npx is on PATH
runtimes.auth: Authenticate the Codex CLI itself. Meridian never asks for a credential and never stores one.

runtimes.name: Minion Code
runtimes.requires: uv, so that uvx is on PATH
runtimes.auth: Configure Minion Code itself. Meridian never asks for a credential and never stores one.
